blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No trips at the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) have been fully booked yet in select routes across the country until November 3, terminal management said on Sunday. In its 4 p.m. Sunday update, PITX said that for November 1, Sunday, the following routes logged the following booking status: 32.56 percent for Bicol; 25.90 percent for Laguna, Batangas, and Quezon (Labazon); 30.19 percent for North Luzon; 9.09 percent for Mindoro; and 19.64 percent for Visayas and Mindanao. For November 2, the following trips were booked: 26.03 percent for Bicol; 6.70 percent for North Luzon; 6.54 percent for Visayas […]...
